scope: Stage 21 server-created one-off AI proposal; PLAN-01 remains the only apply writer.

rawBody.sha256: accepted exact raw body bytes before DTO conversion; digest only is persisted

attemptLedger.stored: ownerId, requestId, rawRequestSha256, state, leaseUntil, sanitized terminal code, immutable AttemptReceipt containing the exact normalized original CalendarDraftResponse tree (capture context and initial PENDING proposal/version); no raw/provider payload.
rules: same requestId with another digest returns 409 ai_request_conflict
PROCESSING or COMMITTING returns 409 ai_in_progress and never calls provider
SUCCEEDED replays the stored normalized typed receipt and proposal identity without provider or a new proposal
FAILED/CANCELLED/INTERRUPTED replay only their sanitized terminal outcome; retry requires a new requestId
deadline is 45 seconds from admission; lease is 60 seconds; an expired crash reservation is atomically marked INTERRUPTED and never restarts provider under that id
owner deletion cleans its attempt rows in the creator-deletion order
FAILED replays 502 ai_invalid_response or its supplied sanitized mapped status; CANCELLED replays 504 ai_timeout; INTERRUPTED replays 409 ai_interrupted.
AttemptReceipt replay never reads current proposal state; it returns the original normalized PENDING response tree even after that proposal becomes terminal.
attemptLedger.commitTicket: DeferredResult timeout/error/completion and worker share one ticket. Cancellation/deadline before final commit ownership atomically yields CANCELLED and zero proposals. Under outer relations.guards(owner), then catalog, owner head and session locks, final transaction may claim COMMITTING immediately before insert while deadline is live. The winning transaction writes proposal and SUCCEEDED receipt together; a later timeout cannot undo that committed result. Failed DB commit leaves no proposal or success receipt and terminalizes FAILED. No DB lock spans provider I/O.

capture.outerGuardAndLocks: relations.guards(owner) is outermost at reserve, capture and final; then catalog read lock -> owner sync head -> current user/session. No code acquires the outer guard after an inner lock.
capture.selectedGyms: empty means full allowed catalog; otherwise candidates are the intersection of live owner-selected gyms and currently available catalog exercises.
capture.factsSql: partial functional numeric finishedAt index for nondeleted owner workouts by (owner, finishedAt, id); MATERIALIZED LIMIT 65 matching parents before any set expansion; reject ai_context_too_large if parent count exceeds 64. Expand only those parents and reject above 8192 fact rows.
capture.facts: window is [startOfDay(capturedLocalDate-27 days in requested IANA zone), capturedAt]. Accept only completed nondeleted facts where parent finishedAt<=capturedAt and startedAt<=factTime<=finishedAt; factTime is completedAt else startedAt. Exclude invalid/future/out-of-window temporal facts and emit a data-quality marker without changing source records.
capture.candidatesSql: owner/kind and catalog indexes, LIMIT 1001 then reject above 1000; every source body and total source bytes are bounded before expansion and any incompatible existing body cap is surfaced as a blocker, never silently loosened.
capture.mass: latest permitted measurement via indexed measuredAt<=capturedAt LIMIT 1; no health ledger or InBody payload.
capture.notes: includeNotes=false excludes all workout/set notes and candidate hints. Otherwise notes must be inside the capture window and <=capturedAt: workout timestamp=finishedAt, set timestamp=factTime, hint timestamp=updatedAt. Sort sourceTime DESC, kind ASC, canonical ID ASC, workoutId/sectionId/setIndex ASC; include at most 20 whole entries/16384 UTF-8 bytes.
capture.privacy: Provider context contains only ProviderIntent, selected live candidates with muscle summaries, bounded profile/mass and opt-in notes/hints, captured local date and quality markers. Raw facts and actual/legacy weight tuples remain in ServerCapture only. No identity, exact DOB, revisions, credentials, raw archive, health/InBody data or future facts cross the provider boundary. Notes are data, never instructions; missing health disclosure neither gates calendar nor permits health data.
capture.sourcePayloadCaps: Before JSON hydration, query only source row keys and encoded lengths. Reject if any eligible source row serialized UTF-8 exceeds 1048576 bytes or the aggregate eligible materialized source bytes exceeds 8388608; then hydrate only finite dependencies: gyms<=1000, equipment<=2000, profile<=1, mass<=1, hints<=1000. Existing sync accepts 10MiB request/16MiB account records; valid sync records may exceed the AI cap and remain untouched.
capture.finalCreator: Calendar final creation uses a new typed bounded internal path with the finite live dependency graph from sourcePayloadCaps, EXISTS active-workout guard and captured server weight projection. It must not call unbounded validateLiveDraft or aiDraftWithHistoryWeights/all-owner scans. It reuses the same validators; normal approval and PLAN-01 equality remain unchanged.
capture.sourceRowAccounting: ServerCapture.sourceRows contains one kind/key/utf8Bytes per fetched source row, not category totals. kind/key pairs are unique. aggregateEligibleSourceBytes is exactly their sum; projected notes do not double-count parent workout payload bytes. The same sourceRows shape is used for over-limit V-006 setup before admission, which intentionally does not validate as an accepted ServerCapture.

ranking.heuristic: goal preference groups, then explicit user priority, then least 28-day mapped-muscle coverage, then canonical UUID
ranking.nonClaim: AI is not required to choose a prefix, fixed seed or any particular type; type groups do not prove a physiological result.
ranking.formula: priority(e)=sum canonical contribution 100/50/0 for e mapped muscles requested by priorityMuscles. coverage(e)=sum, over e nonzero mapped muscles, total completed-set contributions in the 28-day window as integer hundredths; do not infer volume/reps. Context order is goal DESC, priority DESC, coverage ASC, canonical UUID ASC.
ranking.bounds: At most25 muscles each100 means priority<=2500. At most8192 completed facts each contributing at most100 to each of25 muscles means integer coverage<=20480000; these are exact engineering maxima.

provider.transport: existing AiProvider / HttpOpenAiChatCompletionsProvider; calendar uses strict json_schema name calendar_draft and #/$defs/ProviderOutput, store=false, stream=false, at most two in flight, 45s admission deadline, provider body max 262144 bytes.
provider.serverProjection: Provider output omits weightKg, speedKmh and inclinePct. Server writes speedKmh/inclinePct=null. Strength weight uses ServerCapture latest tuple same exercise: factTime DESC, workoutUUID ASC, sectionUUID ASC, setIndex ASC; present actualWeightKg (including null) wins, legacy weightKg only when actual member absent. Other exercise, target and original values never contribute.
provider.duration: Known duration is sum(durationSec for every TIMED/CARDIO set) + sum(restSeconds*(setCount-1) across every exercise, null rest=0); it must be <= availableDurationMinutes*60. Strength duration is not guessed and has no exact-fit assertion.

runtimeSchemaArtifact.topologyParity: runtime resource is ProviderOutput at root with exactly its transitive ProviderExercise, ProviderSet and Uuid definitions; contract/provider tests compare normalized JSON tree and ref topology.

provider.runtimeValidation: unique exerciseId; total plannedSets<=40; canonical resolved type shape: STRENGTH requires reps and durationSec=null, TIMED/CARDIO require durationSec and reps=null; server rejects the whole output otherwise.

CalendarDraftRequest.x-runtime: canonical UUID/ZoneId, trimmed nonblank strings when present, future local date 1970..2100, sorted arrays

PlannedSet.x-runtime: canonical exercise type requires exact permitted null/non-null shape

AttemptReceipt.x-runtime: immutable exact normalized CalendarDraftResponse tree from initial PENDING proposal/version; replay after proposal becomes terminal returns this stored tree without a current-state query.

durationCases.assertion: no exact strength work-time fit claim

nonClaims: engineering bounds are not clinical safety or dose
goal groups do not prove effects

fixtureNotes.references: Fixture refs use RFC6901 pointers within this document. Each vector starts from an independent base fixture; requestPatch replaces named request members and raw bytes/hash are regenerated unless the case supplies exact raw bytes. Expected response is exact normalized domain JSON; API message/localized detail is not matched for errors, code and status are exact.
fixtureNotes.clock: Admission/capture use base admittedAtMillis. The clock advances only at listed operation/barrier timestamps; normal success commits at committedAtMillis.
fixtureNotes.sqlCounts: Count vectors construct that exact number of source rows/facts using distinct UUIDv5(DNS, calendar-fixture-<zero-based-index>) and the base workout/fact shape. Byte vectors pad valid note strings to exact UTF8 serialized payload size before hydration. Assert source row count and bytes in fixture setup.
fixtureNotes.ledger: Valid requests reserve before capture: capture failures persist FAILED with sanitized code/status. Owner deletion removes all ledger rows; workers never recreate them. Invalid raw/request input creates no row.
fixtureNotes.privacy: Facts including actual/legacy weight are server-only. Provider candidates contain only required identifiers and bounded mapped summary, never raw owner archive.
